summary: Mid-cycle rate-tier smoothing not applied to reserved capacity invoice causing temporary negative balance and automated credit hold
description:
Issue summary: BrightScale reported that their March 1 reserved capacity invoice (monthly commit) shows a negative net due and triggered an automated credit hold on their account. This appears to be due to the 'rate-tier smoothing' logic not being applied mid-cycle when the committed baseline was adjusted during a plan change.

Impact: Customer-facing: BrightScale's production inference queues are throttled by our billing protection; they cannot create new dedicated jobs or scale up. Financial: invoice shows -$4,820 net due and a system-generated credit hold applied.

Environment: Dedicated contract, prod-us-east, committed pool ID cp-43-brightscale, billing cycle 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-31.

Steps to reproduce (customer):
1) Customer upgraded reserved capacity from 8->12 GPUs on 2026-03-05 via Console.
2) System issued a mid-cycle pro-rate adjustment and created an interim invoice.
3) On invoice generation, our rate-tier smoothing job should have redistributed usage tiers across the billing cycle but appears not to have run for the affected org.

Observed behavior: Interim invoice line items show a negative charge (credit) without an offsetting pro-rate line, resulting in a negative balance and automatic credit hold. Console shows "billing protection: hold" and customer cannot provision additional capacity.

Expected behavior: Rate-tier smoothing runs after commit changes to reconcile tiered unit pricing across the cycle and produce a balanced invoice with correct pro-rate lines; automated holds should not trigger for expected pro-rate credits without review.

Relevant logs/IDs: invoice id inv-2026-03-07-777, commit id commit-brs-87, queue id q-prod-brs. Billing job run id billing-smo-2026-03-06-22:14.

Temporary workaround: Support applied a manual billing adjustment to clear the hold (see comments). We recommended customer delay provisioning until we confirm balancing is complete.
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: smoothing job failed to pick up org due to a race when commit record updated shortly after midnight UTC.
Findings to date:
- billing-smo logs show job ran at 2026-03-06T22:14Z for pool cp-43-brightscale but returned status 200 with zero operations (no actions taken).
- commit table shows commit-brs-87 updated at 2026-03-05T23:59:58Z; a follow-up metadata write occurred 2026-03-06T00:00:02Z which may have caused the smoothing job's org filter (snapshot_id) mismatch.
- Metering events for 2026-03-05 appear normal; no double-counting.
- Invoice generator applied "auto-credit" when net lines crossed negative threshold; hold logic does not currently account for pending smoothing runs.
Queries run: SELECT * FROM billing_jobs WHERE org='brightscale' AND run_ts BETWEEN '2026-03-05' AND '2026-03-07'; SELECT * FROM commits WHERE id='commit-brs-87';
Preliminary conclusion: race condition between commit update and smoothing job snapshot selection caused the smoothing run to be a no-op for this org. Related: scheduler bug introduced in release 2026.2.4 (see PR #981).
comments: 2026-03-10 Maya Patel: Opened ticket after customer called Support; customer reports provisioning blocked and urgent. Attached invoice inv-2026-03-07-777 and screenshot of Console hold state.
2026-03-10 Diego Alvarez: Acknowledged. Escalating to Billing and SRE. Setting sla_due_at 2026-03-11. Will investigate smoothing job logs and recent deploys.

2026-03-11 SRE - Priya Nair: Found smoothing job run with zero ops for cp-43. Investigating snapshot selection. Noted recent scheduler change in 2026.2.4; marking related PR: github.com/redwood-inference/billing-service/pull/981.

2026-03-11 Billing - Arun Mehta: Manually applied a one-time credit reversal to clear the customer's hold while engineering confirms root cause. Created credit adjustment adj-88921. Customer notified.

2026-03-12 Diego Alvarez: Customer confirmed provisioning restored after manual adjustment. We'll schedule a fix for the scheduler snapshot mismatch and add a guard to prevent auto-hold for pending smoothing windows. Assigned to ENG billing-service squad for release 2026.3.0.
2026-03-12 BrightScale (customer) - Elena V.: Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please confirm root cause and what prevents recurrence. We need assurance before auto-scaling our fleet back up.
resolution: Manual credit adjustment adj-88921 applied to clear hold; workaround in place. Engineering to patch smoothing job snapshot selection and add pre-hold guard. Fix targeted for 2026.3.0 release; follow-up invoice audit scheduled.
next_steps: 1) Engineering to implement snapshot matching fix and add idempotency guard in smoothing job (ENG billing-service). 2) Add rule to hold engine to exclude pending smoothing windows from auto-hold decisions. 3) Run backfill for affected runs between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-08 to detect other orphaned no-op runs. 4) Postmortem and customer communication to be drafted after release.
